notes.note: Reviewed final swipe popup-focus delta at 067e193f97c3: an expanded owned popup keeps its source tray mounted while focus is in the portal, so canceling Snooze restores focus to a visible trigger. The new real Chromium regression failed before the hook fix and passed after it; final browser/geometry run passed 17 tests with one pre-existing skip. Interaction, motion-token and preview documentation remains accurate; no native or installed-runtime qualification.
